sovereign_country.strategic_role: 西欧核心消费市场、高客单价品牌合规与本土清关

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Social Commerce via Short Video Platforms

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Napoleonic Code heritage; unitary national law)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: France-China Bilateral Investment Treaty (signed 21 January 2007; entered into force 26 March 2010)
France-United States Double Taxation Convention (1994; as modified by the BEPS Multilateral Instrument)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Articles L561-1 to L561-60 of the French Monetary and Financial Code (Code monétaire et financier), transposing Directives (EU) 2015/849 and 2018/843 (AMLD4/AMLD5); Article L561-45 et seq. establishing the Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs (RBE); Decree No. 2017-1094 dated 3 August 2017 (UBO filing and consultation rules); Decree No. 2020-115 dated 12 February 2020 (RBE procedures); French General Tax Code Article 1649-0 A (UBO disclosure); Regulation (EU) 2015/847 on information accompanying transfers of funds; FATF Recommendations R.24/R.25 and the French national risk assessment implemented through Tracfin.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized power of attorney (Pouvoir) executed by each foreign incorporating shareholder appointing the French legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the shareholder's home jurisdiction and, where mandatory, the local Chamber of Commerce or French consulate verifying the notary's seal
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (if the country of origin is a party to the Hague Apostille Convention 1961) or, if non-party, French Consular Legalization via the French embassy/consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of the passport or national identity card of each beneficial owner (UBO) of the SAS
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public, competent national registry authority, or French diplomatic/consular post in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille for copies issued by public authorities; if issued by a notary, notary's signature and chamber of notaries apostille

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Sworn French translation of the articles of association and corporate purpose where the source text is in a foreign language; approved by a French sworn translator registered with the relevant Cour d'appel
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Traducteur agréé (court-approved sworn translator) from the list of a French Cour d'appel
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: No apostille on the translation itself, but the underlying original document must be apostilled/legalized and the translation must be appended to the apostilled original

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors and signatories against: (1) the French 'Sécurité financière' list and ACPR published PEP lists; (2) the EU Council consolidated financial sanctions list; (3) the UN Security Council consolidated list; (4) Tracfin's relevant financial-risk and reporting guidance; (5) OFAC's SDN/Blocked Persons list where any USD settlement is contemplated; and (6) internal risk-based adverse-media checks. Screening must be completed before registry filing and before bank/TikTok Shop payout onboarding, repeated on a trigger/event basis, and records retained for at least five years after termination of the business relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: INPI - Guichet unique des formalités d'entreprises (https://formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr); RCS public database via Infogreffe (https://www.infogreffe.fr)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: French law (Law No. 94-665 of 4 August 1994, 'Loi Toubon') and Articles L123-12, R123-37 et seq. of the French Commercial Code require the corporate name to be written in French using the Latin alphabet and accepted characters. A name containing foreign or transliterated words must be accompanied by a French translation or explanatory phrase in the articles of association. Non-Latin scripts (e.g., Chinese characters) must be rendered phonetically into Latin characters and include a French descriptive component. The legal form 'SAS' must appear as the final element of the company name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: French law does not provide a stand-alone pre-incorporation name reservation. Protection of the corporate name is effective upon successful registration of the company with the RCS. If the Guichet unique or the Commercial Court registrar rejects the name, the applicant may (i) file a rectification request addressing the cited irregularity, (ii) immediately submit a revised corporate name, and/or (iii) appeal the refusal to the supervising judge of the Commercial Court (juge commis à la surveillance du registre du commerce et des sociétés) within 15 days of the refusal notice. The appeal is initiated by petition (requête) and is subject to the judge's procedural discretion.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted only through licensed domiciliation companies under Article L123-11-1 of the French Commercial Code and R123-160 et seq. A pure virtual address without any operational element is not sufficient for an e-commerce retail entity. The domiciliation company must be approved, the domiciliation contract must cover at least three months, and mail must be handled at the declared address. For TikTok Shop retail activities, a French operational contact, adequate accounting records and a verifiable office arrangement are required to prevent the tax administration from disregarding the registered office substance and applying Article 1649-0 A or CFC-type rules.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 0.10 (10% annual probability for a correctly domiciled non-licensed retail e-commerce company; increases to 0.35 if the registered office is only a virtual mailbox or if a UBO appears on a PEP or high-risk-list).

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Corporate legal drafting of SAS articles of association, shareholder agreement, and statutory filing package
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French avocat or corporate legal service provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for standard French SAS incorporation package

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Government registration and RCS filing duty (immatriculation au registre du commerce et des sociétés)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce compétent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory greffe tariff and decree authorities applicable to the company's registered office jurisdiction

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Publication of the incorporation notice in a legal gazette (Journal d'Annonces Légales)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Journal d'Annonces Légales authorized by the prefecture
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff per line of text set by the local prefecture

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, apostille, and consular authentication of foreign shareholders' power of attorney and identity documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public, local Chamber of Commerce in the home jurisdiction, and French consulate
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Consular tariff and prevailing notarial/authentication market benchmark per document

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Sworn French translation of corporate documents and legal opinions
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Traducteur agréé registered with a French Cour d'appel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Court-approved translator tariff (approximately 20–40 EUR per page)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/KYC due diligence, UBO piercing, PEP and sanctions screening by a corporate services firm
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French AML compliance provider / corporate services firm
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for integrated KYC/AML screening package

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office domiciliation contract (minimum 12-month service by licensed domiciliation company)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for commercial domiciliation in Paris or a major French business center

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce) — Articles L. 227-1 to L. 227-27 for the Société par Actions Simplifiée (SAS); Article L. 123-1 et seq. for registration at the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS); Décret n° 84-406 of 30 May 1984 on RCS formalities; Code de l'environnement for conditional ICPE obligations.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce acting through the Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI) single digital counter at formalities.inpi.fr; Infogreffe portal for RCS extracts; supervisory authority of the Ministère de la Justice.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Statuts (Articles of Association) accompanied by the M0 Declaration of Incorporation (Cerfa n° 10945*02) filed electronically via the INPI formalities portal and registered at the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés, resulting in issuance of the Kbis extract.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No legal minimum share capital under Article L. 227-2 Code de commerce; capital is fixed freely in the statuts; at least 50% of the subscribed capital must be paid up at formation, with the balance due within five years; paid-up funds must be deposited in a blocked non-interest-bearing escrow account (compte bloqué) opened in the name of the company en formation at a French credit institution or with the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations and are released only upon RCS registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: The subscribers, having approved the draft Articles of Association, RESOLVE as follows: (1) The share capital of the SAS, as stated in Article 7 of the Articles, is fully subscribed, with at least 50% thereof paid up and deposited in a blocked escrow bank account pending registration at the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés. (2) The registered office is hereby adopted at the address indicated in Article 4, within the jurisdiction of the Paris Commercial Court. (3) [Name] is appointed President of the SAS with the widest powers of management, and [Name] is appointed Statutory Auditor. (4) The President shall complete all filing, publication and registration formalities before the Greffe and the competent authorities.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Availability Verification and Reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI) database at data.inpi.fr; Infogreffe RCS register consultation; reservation effect accomplished through the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce at filing.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Screen the proposed corporate name against the RCS register and the INPI trademark database to detect identical or confusingly similar prior rights; select a name comprising at least three distinct elements where possible; note that under French practice the corporate name is protected only upon registration at the RCS; reserve the name commercially before engaging substantive documentation.
required_dossiers: Proposed corporate name with supporting distinct elements
Short statement of the corporate purpose
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Greffe or INPI flags identical or confusingly similar pre-existing rights, propose a revised name and re-run the availability check; conflicts with third-party trademarks are resolved by negotiation, consent, or name amendment before filing; statutory remedies lie before the competent Tribunal de Commerce for bad-faith opposition.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of the Statuts (Articles of Association)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Private-deed signature by all shareholders under Article L. 227-2 Code de commerce; notarial act mandatory only where contributions include real property.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the statuts setting forth the legal form (SAS), corporate name, registered office, corporate purpose covering ISIC 4791 social-commerce retail, share capital and breakdown of cash and in-kind contributions, classes and rights of shares, governance clauses (President and optional Director General), decision-making rules, statutory auditor appointment, and restrictions on share transfers; execute the statuts by all incorporators and the first President; if in-kind contributions exist, append the contribution auditor's special report.
required_dossiers: Full or condensed draft of the statuts
Identity and nationality evidence of all incorporators
Bank or notary certificate of capital deposit
Report of the contribution auditor (if in-kind contribution)
Acceptance letters of the President and the Statutory Auditor
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Omissions or errors in the statuts may be corrected by a rectificatory deed (acte rectificatif) passed by unanimous shareholders; if the original deed was notarized, the rectification must also be notarized.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Deposit of Share Capital in a Blocked Escrow Account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French credit institution (banque) or Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations (CDC).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct the company's representative to open a non-interest-bearing blocked account (compte bloqué) in the name of the company en formation; deposit at least 50% of the subscribed capital; obtain the attestation de dépôt des fonds (blocking certificate) identifying each subscriber and the amount paid; funds remain pledged until RCS registration and are then released to the company; if registration is ultimately refused, funds are returned to subscribers upon bank instruction.
required_dossiers: Identity of each subscriber making payment
Bank transfer references or cash deposit slip
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the blocking certificate contains incorrect subscriber or amount data, the bank reissues a corrected attestation; where the statutory blocking period is exceeded and registration is blocked, an application may be made to the President of the Tribunal de Commerce for an order directing release or prolongation of the blocking.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of the Constitutional Notice in a Legal Announcements Journal
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Journal d'Annonces Légales (JAL) authorised in the département of the registered office; official list published by the Prefecture.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the mandatory incorporation notice (avis de constitution) containing the corporate name, legal form, corporate purpose, share capital, registered office address, duration, first President, and the registry of registration (RCS); deliver the notice to the authorised JAL; pay the insertion fees; obtain the attestation de parution evidencing publication, which is required for the filing dossier.
required_dossiers: Draft of the avis de constitution
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the JAL refuses insertion because of unpaid fees or incomplete statutory mentions, cure by verifying the mandated content and resubmitting the corrected notice; a new insertion is ordered and the new attestation de parution is used for filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic Filing of the Incorporation Dossier with the INPI and the Greffe
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI single digital counter (formalities.inpi.fr) transmitting to the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce for registration at the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete and file the M0 / Cerfa n° 10945 declaration together with the signed statuts, attestation de parution, attestation de dépôt des fonds, justification of the domiciliation of the registered office (lease, domiciliation contract, or free-occupation certificate), identity documents and declaration of non-conviction of the President, and the list of beneficial owners (UBO declaration); pay the greffe fee; the Greffe verifies legal compliance and issues the SIREN number.
required_dossiers: Identity and criminal-record declaration of officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: The Greffe issues a non-receivability notice listing missing items; rectify the dossier within the 15-day legal period via the INPI portal; upon cure, the Greffe re-examines the file within 2 working days; unreasonable refusal may be contested before the President of the Tribunal de Commerce for an order compelling registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Delivery of Kbis Extract and Post-Registration Administrative Setup
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Kbis extract); INSEE (SIRET allocation); URSSAF (social registration); DREETS (employment, labour and health inspection).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Collect the Kbis extract constituting the official certificate of incorporation and conclusive proof of legal personality; verify all legal mentions therein; complete post-registration obligations: URSSAF registration within 8 days, TVA compliance notification (auto-attributed in France), customs and single-window data declaration if cross-border elements exist, and publication of corporate acts in the RCS; maintain the share register (registre des mouvements de titres) and the register of corporate decisions.
required_dossiers: Corporate governance registers (share register and decision registers)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Apply to the Greffe for correction of material clerical errors in the Kbis (rectification d'erreur matérielle); if the SIRET number is not allocated, request re-exportation from INSEE; late URSSAF registration is cured by filing an explanatory letter and settling any assessed social contributions.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable for ISIC 4791 / NAICS 454110 social-commerce online retail — no industrial operating licence is imposed by the Code de commerce or the Code de la consommation; only where the operator runs a fulfillment warehouse does the DREAL/DRIEAT (Inspection des Installations Classées pour la Protection de l'Environnement) intervene under Rubrique 1510 of the ICPE nomenclature requiring either declaration, registration, or authorization based on surface-area thresholds.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No separate operating license is mandated. The operating framework is the Kbis RCS registration with the compulsory online-commerce consumer obligations under Articles L. 121-16 et seq. Code de la consommation, the transposed E-Commerce Directive provisions, GDPR compliance, and the annual extended-producer-responsibility declarations under the AGEC anti-waste law.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministère de la Transition Écologique — Inspection des Installations Classées pour la Protection de l'Environnement; DREAL at regional level, DRIEAT for Île-de-France.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt (no EIA required) for the core online-retail activity. Pursuant to Article R. 512-46 Code de l'environnement and the ICPE nomenclature, an environmental assessment arises only if a fulfillment warehouse exceeds the Rubrique 1510 thresholds: regime Déclaration from 850 m² to 15,000 m² of storage floor area, regime Enregistrement/Autorisation above 15,000 m².
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Core activity: no industrial discharges or emissions; compliance required with the AGEC Act (Loi n° 2020-105) for waste sorting and recovery of at least three waste fractions at company premises; registration with the national extended-producer-responsibility register for household packaging; REACH and CE conformity placed on consumer goods; for any ancillary ICPE-registered warehouse, wastewater and VOC thresholds of the arrêté ministériel of 3 October 2010 apply, including fire-water retention and waste-handling standards.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety: premises must comply with the Code de la construction et de l'habitation; the fire-safety opinion (avis du SDIS / Commission de Sécurité) is mandatory only for premises open to the public (ERP classification), which is inapplicable to internet-only retail unless a physical showroom is operated; for ICPE-listed warehouses, fire-prevention obligations are enforced by DREAL. Structural load: the building-code conformity attestation required by Décret n° 2019-522 must be delivered by a certified inspector. Occupational clearance: registration with DREETS, employee medical-fitness visits under the Code du travail, and the mandatory Document Unique d'Évaluation des Risques Professionnels (DUERP) established and updated in consultation with the social and economic committee.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) under the Ministry of Economy, Finance and Industrial and Digital Sovereignty; online portal: impots.gouv.fr. VAT registration for non-established businesses is handled by the Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE) in the competent territorial department, with certain centralised units for non-residents.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity not established in France but making taxable supplies of goods or services in France must obtain a French VAT number (numéro de TVA intracommunautaire) before carrying out taxable transactions. For non-EU established entities, France generally requires the appointment of an accredited fiscal representative, who applies for the VAT number on behalf of the foreign principal. For EU-established entities, direct application is possible by submitting Form 3571 (one-off registration) or via the EU One-Stop-Shop for distance sales; for permanent establishments an SIREN number is first obtained through the formalities centre (Centre de Formalités des Entreprises). Supporting documentation includes proof of identity of the legal representative, articles of association, certificate of tax residence from the home jurisdiction, evidence of economic activity, and the expected date of first taxable transaction. The SIE issues the VAT number within a statutory timeframe once the application is complete, subject to anti-fraud verification.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Under French general tax law, an SAS is mandatorily subject to corporate income tax (impôt sur les sociétés) at entity level; no check-the-box or pass-through election exists for SAS. Available elections relevant to group structures include the formation of a French tax consolidation group (intégration fiscale) with a 95% ownership threshold; the territoriality election for global consolidated profits under specific rules; and the option for partnerships and other transparent entities to elect corporate income tax. Hybrid mismatch effects are constrained by the French implementation of the ATAD anti-hybrid rules, which operate through disallowance and inclusion adjustments rather than elective classifications.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: For entities established in France, the small-business exemption threshold for supplies of goods and retail-like activities is EUR 85,000 of annual turnover (EUR 37,500 for most services), as indexed upward for goods in certain cases; however, for non-established foreign sellers and distance sales to final consumers via online marketplaces there is no registration threshold and VAT registration is compulsory from the first taxable transaction. Under the EU e-commerce package, the EU wide distance sales threshold is EUR 10,000, above which supplies are taxed in the country of destination unless the seller uses the Union One-Stop-Shop; France applies destination VAT to all such sales by non-established suppliers.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: France is progressively implementing mandatory structured e-invoicing for B2B transactions from 1 September 2026 (large enterprises) and 1 September 2027 (small and medium enterprises), with B2C transactions subject to mandatory e-reporting. Invoices must be transmitted through the public portal (Portail Public de Facturation, PPF) or through certified dematerialisation platforms (Plateformes de Dématérialisation Partenaires, PDPs) using formats such as Factur-X/Mixed, EDI, or agreed structured XML schemas. There is no general real-time fiscal clearance or stamping regime for VAT on e-commerce supplies; however, certified cash-register or sales-management software must comply with French tax fraud prevention requirements (NF 525, NF 203, or equivalent) and guarantee tamper-proof audit trails. For cross-border B2B services and goods subject to reverse charge, the obligation is to issue invoices stating the reverse-charge rule and to submit recapitulative EC sales lists and Intrastat declarations where applicable.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of movable goods outside the EU are zero-rated for French VAT provided the goods are physically dispatched or transported out of the EU under commercial documents satisfying the proof-of-export conditions. Offshore services and intangible supplies are not automatically zero-rated; they are treated under the B2B place-of-supply rules and are usually outside French VAT when performed for a taxable person established outside France, subject to the recipient's taxable status, the nature of the service, and the effective use and enjoyment rules. For retail e-commerce exports via TikTok Shop or similar platforms, the SAS must be the exporter of record or hold evidence that the goods left the EU through its own logistics arrangements; goods sold through online marketplaces that import and fulfil within the EU are not zero-rated at the French export stage and may instead fall under import VAT and deemed supply rules.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: French customs and tax authorities apply stringent documentary consistency tests to export zero-rating claims. If the required export evidence is not produced on demand, or is insufficient, the VAT initially zero-rated is clawed back with late-payment interest (intérêts de retard, currently 0.20% per month) and additional penalties: 10% for absence of declaration, 40% for deliberate underdeclaration, 80% for fraudulent abuse of law, plus an additional tax abuse penalty and potential criminal fines for customs fraud where the export declaration is falsified. The statute of limitations for VAT adjustments is generally up to six years in cases of fraud or active concealment, and the burden of proof of satisfaction of the zero-rating condition rests on the exporting SAS. Failure to repatriate export proceeds within 180 days may also trigger exchange-control penalties and, where the unrepatriated amount is treated as a distribution or residual profit, additional income tax exposure.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France operates a fully convertible currency regime under EU law and national FX regulations. Both current account transactions and capital movements are unrestricted for resident entities. Profit remittances to shareholders face no capital controls or surrender obligations. All FX transactions exceeding €10,000 must be declared to the Banque de France through the Système Economique et Financier (SEPA) reporting mechanism for statistical, monetary policy, and AML monitoring purposes.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory surrender or conversion of export proceeds required under French law. Companies may retain foreign currency receipts in offshore or domestic FX accounts. Export receipts must be statistically declared to customs authorities via the Single Administrative Document (SAD) process. FX transactions remain subject to full AML/KYC verification with no statutory timeline for conversion or repatriation.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: High viability for licensed EMI partnerships including Wise Business and PayPal Business under PSD2 and French EMI licensing framework. TikTok Shop payout integration requires compliance with French banking secrecy, AML, and tax reporting obligations. Remote video KYC onboarding is fully permitted for established French SAS entities.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote video KYC and interview permitted for French SAS entities provided valid corporate and director identification documents are supplied. Physical presence is not mandatory for standard onboarding but may be required for enhanced due diligence, large transaction volumes, or specific regulatory triggers.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unexplained source of funds or high-volume inflows inconsistent with declared social commerce activity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: TikTok Shop payout reports, bank statements, VAT returns, business registration certificates, and detailed transaction reconciliation showing legitimate retail operations

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border capital injections exceeding normal business cycle patterns
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Underlying commercial contracts, export/import declarations, and proof of arm's-length trade activity

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound transfers via SWIFT MT103 or SEPA Instant to French IBAN accounts. Required purpose codes include 'Capital Contribution', 'Trade Settlement', or 'Social Commerce Payout'. All transactions undergo full KYC/AML screening and Banque de France declaration if thresholds are met. Integration with Wise B2B and TikTok Shop payout rails is permissible when accompanied by proper tax classification and reporting.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails include SWIFT MT103 for international payments, Commercial Letters of Credit for trade finance, and SEPA transfers within the Eurozone. All disbursements require reference to underlying trade documents and automated AML transaction screening.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Filing of Annual Accounts and Corporate Tax Return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 3 months after the end of the financial year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalties of 0.5% of the tax amount per month of delay, capped at 25%; non-compliance may result in administrative strike-off after three months

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Filing of Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) Information
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) - infogreffe
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month of any change in shareholding or UBO; annual confirmation if no changes
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines up to 7,500 EUR and potential removal from the RCS register

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Annual turnover exceeding €800,000 and/or total assets exceeding €400,000 (French Commercial Code Article L.823-1)

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annual confirmation of shareholding and UBO details filed with RCS; update within one month of any share transfer or control change

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: 1,500 - 4,000 USD (if audit mandated; lower or none if thresholds not met)
